body:
## Summary

`G2SwaptionEngine::calculate()` rejects every `Settlement::Cash` swaption outright, including `CollateralizedCashPrice`, even though its valuation never reads `settlementType`/`settlementMethod` again after the guard and has the same payoff for `Physical` and `Cash`+`CollateralizedCashPrice` settlement — the two differ only in whether the underlying swap is physically entered into or cash-settled after exercise, not in price.

Every other engine performing the same style of valuation (replicating the exercise payoff from the underlying swap's own cashflows under a short-rate model) already guards with the strictly broader `settlementMethod != Settlement::ParYieldCurve`:

- `JamshidianSwaptionEngine`
- `Gaussian1dJamshidianSwaptionEngine`
- `Gaussian1dSwaptionEngine`
- `Gaussian1dNonstandardSwaptionEngine`
- `Gaussian1dFloatFloatSwaptionEngine`
- `TreeSwaptionEngine`

which admits `CollateralizedCashPrice` and rejects only `ParYieldCurve` (the one convention whose payoff genuinely differs — it needs an annuity-based formula none of these engines implement). `G2SwaptionEngine` appears to have been missed when the other six were updated to this convention; this brings it in line with the rest of the module.

## Test plan

- Added `testG2SwaptionEngineCashSettlement` in `test-suite/bermudanswaption.cpp`: prices the same European swaption under `Settlement::Physical` and `Settlement::Cash`+`CollateralizedCashPrice` with `G2SwaptionEngine` and checks the NPVs match, and confirms `Cash`+`ParYieldCurve` is still correctly rejected.
- Verified the new test fails with the old guard (`cash-settled swaptions not priced with G2 engine`) and passes with the fix.
- Ran the full `BermudanSwaptionTests` suite (`testCachedValues`, `testCachedG2Values`, `testTreeEngineTimeSnapping`, `testBermudanOISSwaptionWithHW`, `testBermudanOISSwaptionWithG2`, `testBermudanOISSwaptionPreservesFeatures`) — all pass.

🤖 Co-worked with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
